title: Length of Relationship and the Operating Lines of Credit Late Charge
content:
The longer ago an Operating Lines of Credit line was first booked, the smaller the share of a late charge the member is charged.

## Rule

The member is charged:

- **0.5 of the figure** when the line was first booked 120 or more whole months before today;
- **0.8 of the figure** when it was first booked at least 60 but fewer than 120 whole months before today;
- **the whole figure** when it was first booked fewer than 60 whole months before today.

The figure is the charge base multiplied by the late charge percentage, and the share acts on it before it is rounded to cents and before the minimum and maximum late charge are applied. The first booking date is the booking date recorded on the line; a renewal does not change it.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, today 15 October)

| Line first booked | Whole months before today | Share charged |
|---|---|---|
| 15 October, ten years earlier | 120 | 0.5 |
| 16 October, ten years earlier | 119 | 0.8 |
| 15 October, five years earlier | 60 | 0.8 |
| 16 October, five years earlier | 59 | Whole |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A figure of USD 120.00 on a line first booked eleven years ago is charged on 0.5 of itself, USD 60.00, before the product's minimum and maximum late charge are applied; on a Revolving Operating Line, whose minimum is USD 35, the charge is then USD 60.00.
